conclusions: FRD17 fixes Account/contact/external-link canonical resources, states, uniqueness, age provenance and immutable identity keys. ADR0006 already chooses ASP.NET Identity/OpenIddict; no duplicate Product/technology decision is needed.

Catalog32 permits detailed executable typed contracts and schema during implementation. Doc02 requires domain/infrastructure separation; P1 outbox and concurrency primitives are reusable technical mechanics.

Foundation resources here are Account and append-only state versions, contacts, immutable provider-subject links, plus framework credential/protocol stores. Session/device/recovery/restriction and other workflow-specific projections remain in their already registered owning P2 slices.

This work activates no registration, login, cookie, server token issuance, provider call or Product role/membership behavior. Connection settings are explicit; security policy settings remain absent until the owning workflow resolves them.

FRD29 requires field/processing review before production. Local schema includes no DOB/raw identity document columns and adds no retention/deletion timeline. Populated downgrade must reject data loss and direct Account/history mutation must preserve identity/version lineage.
The active P2-002 work is still VALIDATION, so its shared solution ownership is revalidated at this new committed candidate without rewriting completed historical P0/P1 records.
scope_boundary: Local Account/Identity persistence and store foundation only; no endpoint or runtime authentication policy activation.
